title: Disable or restore a team login
summary: End workspace access while preserving the person’s working profile and history.

sections.title: Choose the correct action
sections.body: Disable login to end access to the workspace. Change the working profile to inactive to stop new bookings. These are separate actions; disabling login alone does not remove future bookability.

sections.title: Disable access
sections.body:
1. Open **Team & availability → Access**, or the person’s profile **Access** section.
2. Select **Disable login…**.
3. Read the confirmation, enter the **Required reason** and select **Disable login**.
4. Confirm the state becomes **Disabled**. Their sessions end, while their working profile and appointment history remain.

sections.title: Restore access
sections.body:
1. Open the disabled person’s **Access** section.
2. Enter **Reason to restore access**.
3. Select **Reactivate login**.
4. Review their role, capabilities and accessible locations before they resume work.

sections.title: Protected access
sections.body: You cannot use this screen to disable your own account. Only an owner can change another owner’s access. If you are removing a person from daily operations, also review their future appointments, working profile and service assignments.
